<notes>
All three rollouts succeeded with the correct answer (19 occurrences of 'e'). Verified independently: border(1) cherry(1) marker(1) border(1) garden(1) border(1) clover(1) marker(1) reward(1) border(1) marker(1) terror(1) stream(1) stream(1) error(1) barrier(1) garden(1) barrier(1) river(1) = 19.

No divergence among the runs (all three returned "19"). No repeated errors or mechanical failures. No ignored invariant or ignored output. The current harness correctly loads the system prompt and task template, calls the LLM once, and returns the last line of the reply. The extraction of the final answer from prose is working as intended across all runs.

No evidence of any problem that a change would address. The mission guidance is explicit: "Do not fix what the runs already got right" and "If you cannot name the moment [in a trajectory], the edit is speculation and costs context for nothing." There is no moment here.
</notes>
